dependencies.required_evidence: Preserve the exact Endpoint428 population, route identity, record ABI, explicit-key-only predictive population, incremental inverse, resource limits, and zero-credit boundary.

contract.reason: The frozen prose correctly requires prediction at coordinate i to depend only on truths through i-1, but its same-availability ordering placed posttruth exits after prediction and described an ambiguous P/R update as available at i+1. Both statements conflict with that causal boundary.
exact_schedule: At availability coordinate i, first apply a deferred literal update from source i-2 only when truth i-1 has shown that the possible P/R pair was not PP/RR syntax.
Next apply all structural posttruth actions caused by source i-1, including route entry, field exit, template entry or exit, and overflow transitions.
Then freeze prediction eligibility for source i from the resulting parser state. The implementation must do this before reading WRT byte i.
Only after prediction eligibility is frozen may the scanner read and decode WRT byte i, extend the raw frontier, and perform posttruth actions whose availability is i+1.

A possible P/R at source i is unresolved until truth i+1 is decoded. If literal, its route-history update first becomes available at i+2. If i is the final source byte, the known end of the frozen stream permits its literal update at the terminal boundary wrt_stream_bytes, where no later prediction exists.
PP/RR syntax never enters the containing route history. The prediction that existed for either delimiter byte remains in the tape because its eligibility was fixed pretruth.
equal_availability_record_order: deferred_value_update derived from earlier source bytes
posttruth structural records derived from the immediately prior decoded byte, preserving parser emission order
field_value_byte prediction for the current source byte

coordinate_invariants.prediction: event 3 has availability_wrt_coordinate equal to source_wrt_coordinate
coordinate_invariants.ordinary_posttruth: events 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9 have availability_wrt_coordinate equal to source_wrt_coordinate plus one
coordinate_invariants.deferred_literal: event 4 normally has availability_wrt_coordinate equal to source_wrt_coordinate plus two; only an unresolved final source byte may use the terminal availability source plus one
coordinate_invariants.eof: EOF does not synthesize template or field exits. It may resolve only the final pending possible P/R as a literal because the complete frozen population ends there.

implementation_proof: RouteParser::PreparePretruth is called before getc reads the current WRT truth.
The independent verifier rejects decreasing availability, prediction-before-state-action order at equal availability, illegal event/flag combinations, and illegal source-to-availability deltas.
A source-only fixture must contain explicit, positional, nested, delimiter, final-pending, overflow, and atom-boundary cases and must produce byte-identical A/B artifacts.

activation_requirements: This addendum and the complete candidate source tree are sealed before any fixture receipt or complete route-tape build is used as evidence.
Only bounded source fixtures may run while the Endpoint428 HORIZON retained-parent gate is active.
A complete route-tape build remains forbidden until that active gate terminalizes.
